title: Evaluation of Keratinocyte Proliferation on Two- and Three-dimensional Type I Collagen Substrates
protocol: Perform all procedures for keratinocyte culture medium under aseptic conditions.
Add 5 mL of penicillin-streptomycin to 500 mL of K110 Type-II medium using a pipette.
Add 10 mL of additive supplement K-1 to the mixture with penicillin-streptomycin and K110 Type-II medium using a pipette.
Perform procedures for fibril form of type I collagen under aseptic conditions until step 2.6.
Keep 10x phosphate-buffered saline (PBS (-)), deionized water, collagen, a 96-well culture plate, and an empty 2-mL tube on ice.
Add 1.12 mL of deionized water to an empty 2 mL tube using a pipette.
Add 200 µL of 10x PBS (-) to the deionized water in the 2 mL tube using a pipette.
Gently shake the tube several times.
Add 0.66 mL of collagen to the 2 mL tube using a pipette.
Gently and quickly shake the tube several times.
Avoid bubble formation in the solution as much as possible.
Pour 100 µL of the collagen solution into each well of the 96-well culture plate.
Gently shake the culture plate in a left to right motion.
Cover the entire surface of the wells with the collagen solution.
Spread the solution using a pipette tip if necessary.
Avoid bubble formation in the solution as much as possible.
Place the culture plate in a CO2 incubator.
Incubate the culture plate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Check the gelation of collagen by tilting the culture plate.
Move the culture plate to a clean bench.
Gently pour 150 µL of K110 on the gels using a pipette along the wall of the well.
Place the culture plate back in the CO2 incubator and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Move the culture plate to a clean bench.
Prior to cell culture, gently discard K110 using a pipette.
Add 4 µL of collagen to 1.2 mL of 1 mM hydrochloric acid (HCl) in a 1.5 mL tube.
Gently mix the solution using a pipette.
Pour 100 µL of collagen into each well of a 96-well culture plate using a pipette.
Gently shake the culture plate left to right and incubate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Discard the collagen solution after incubation.
Wash the wells with PBS (-) twice using a pipette.
Pour 150 µL of 1% bovine serum albumin/PBS (-) (1% BSA) into each well.
Incubate the culture plate at room temperature for 1 hour.
Discard the 1% BSA prior to cell culture.
Maintain FEPE1L-8 cells in K110 in a CO2 incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO2 until semi-confluency.
Prepare K110, trypsin, and trypsin inhibitor in a water bath at 37 °C.
Remove the medium from the culture dish.
Add 3 mL of 0.05% trypsin to the culture dish using a pipette.
Place the dish in a CO2 incubator and incubate at 37 °C for 5 min.
Check cell detachment from the surface of the culture dish using phase-contrast microscopy at 10x magnification.
Add 3 mL of trypsin inhibitor to collect detached cells.
Transfer the detached cells into a 15 mL centrifuge tube using a pipette.
Centrifuge the cells in a 15 mL centrifuge tube at 200 x g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant and re-suspend the pellet in 10 mL of K110 using a pipette.
Count the cells using phase-contrast microscopy at 10x magnification.
Prepare cell concentration at 5.0 x 10^4 cells/mL by appropriate dilution with K110.
Seed 0.1 mL of K110 with cells in each well of the culture plate using a pipette along the wall of the well.
Place the culture plate in a CO2 incubator and incubate at 37 °C for the indicated time (2 h, 1 day, 3 days).
Incubate K110 in a water bath at 37 °C.
Mix 130 μL of tetrazolium salt WST-8 and 1.3 mL of K110 in a 2-mL tube using a pipette.
Discard the K110 from the culture plate gently with a pipette.
Wash non-adherent cells away with K110 by using a pipette.
Add 110 μL of K110 mixed with WST-8 in each well using a pipette.
Incubate the culture plate at 37 °C for 2 h in a CO2 incubator.
Collect 100 µL of conditioned medium from each well and move it into another 96-well culture plate.
Measure absorbance at a wavelength of 450 nm (OD450) using a microplate reader.
